text:
ana: kicking off EU blue->green router shift for user-service. pin v2 on green. plan: 10% increments every 3m, hold checks at each step. quiet window 02:00-04:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: [router-shift] started user-service -> green; current weight: 0% -> 0% (step 0)

mike: on watch, I'll run p95 dashboards and keep an eye on error rates :eyes:

jamie: release notes updated: https://redwood.internal/releases/user-service-v2; rollback playbook linked there.

deploy-bot: step 1 applied; green=10%.

ana: looks good, monitoring traces and tail logs for anomalies.

deploy-bot: step 2 applied; green=20%.

deploy-bot: step 3 applied; green=30%.

deploy-bot: alert: p95 latency on green nodes spiked to 420ms (baseline 120ms). source: metrics-eu-agg.

sre-oncall: seeing increased 5xxs from green pool, investigating routing headers and connection errors.

mike: I can reproduce on curl to green; sample trace id: trace-0x9c3f.

ana: hold shift. pause at 30%. don't proceed to next step. if error rate > 2% for next 3m we rollback.

deploy-bot: shift paused at 30% per request from ana. no further steps.

sre-oncall: quick check: green host pool has a mix of older kernel and weird keepalive drops. isolating nodes now.

mike: given 5xxs and p95, I recommend rollback to blue. :roll_back:

lucy: +1 rollback. I'll capture heap profiles and logs for green nodes before they get drained.

deploy-bot: rollback requested by 2 participants. initiating rollback: routing weights -> blue 100%, green 0%.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. current weight: blue=100%. pinned version removed from router config.

ana: thanks team. good call. will open a short postmortem and schedule a targeted canary with a smaller shard and upgraded kernel.

jamie: noted for release notes: add 'pause and rollback' entry and link to postmortem when ready.

lucy: filing infra ticket to replace suspect kernel images in EU pool: INFRA-1427.

mike: keeping watch for any lingering errors. will update once metrics normalize.

sre-oncall: metrics back to baseline after rollback. closing watch.
